en.title: Butterfly, Flutter By! 🦋🌸 | Garden Dance Song for Toddlers | Momo Time
en.description:
Flutter like a butterfly and sway beside a flower! Sing and dance in the garden with Momo.

Two simple learning words for toddlers ages 2–4: BUTTERFLY and FLOWER.
• Open your arms and follow the butterfly.
• Smell a flower and smile.
• Sing the short repeating chorus and move from side to side.

#MomoTime #ToddlerSongs #ButterflySong #FlowerSong #NurseryRhymes #KidsSongs #SingAlong #ToddlerDance #PreschoolSongs #GardenSong
